newsitem.title: USA: MHM Services secures $4 mln credit line.
newsitem.headline: MHM Services secures $4 mln credit line.

text.p: MHM Services Inc said on Friday that one of its subsidiaries has entered into a new $4 million revolving credit facility with an affiliate of Bethesda, Maryland-based commercial lender HealthCare Financial Partners Inc.
The MHM subsidiary, MHM Extended Care Services, intends to use the facility for working capital purposes and to fund continued expansion.
The facility, which bears interest at prime plus 2.25 percent, is secured by accounts receivable and expires in March 1999, the company said.
